title: Combinatorics of Ramsey ideals
summary: We primarily study several combinatorial properties of Ramsey-type ideals on countably infinite sets. Specifically, we show new combinatorial characterizations of Ramsey ideals through various partition and convergence properties. Furthermore, we analyze ideal versions of some relevant high-dimensional Ramsey-type theorems, in order to research ideals related to finite colorings of barriers on the natural numbers as well as ideals associated with finite partitions of any family of finite subsets of the natural numbers.
